BuyAccount.description:
Buy a single Telegram account from the given country and quality tier.

Reserves an available account, charges the buyer's balance (after applying any
eligible discount) and returns the reserved phone number. The login code is not
delivered here — the buyer retrieves it separately via GetCodeAccount.

On any failure after reservation, the reservation is released and the charge refunded.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Case-insensitive on input, normalized to lowercase.

section.description: Quality tier of the account to buy. Determines pricing and availability.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

price.description: Amount deducted from the buyer's balance for this account.

403.USER_BANNED_FROM_BUYING: You are banned from buying accounts. Ban duration: {value}s

409.ACCOUNT_FOR_BUY_SECTION_CLOSED: Buying is not allowed for {context[country]} country {context[section]} account section at the moment
409.ACCOUNT_PURCHASE_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: All purchase attempts have been exhausted without acquiring an account
409.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: You are does not have enough balance for this operation
409.NO_ACCOUNTS_AVAILABLE_FOR_COUNTRY: No accounts available for purchase in this country

BuySessions.description:
Place a bulk order for ready-made Telegram session files.

Reserves up to `qty` accounts from the given country and quality tier, charges the
buyer's balance and queues the order for background processing. Returns immediately
with the order record; delivery progress is polled via GetBuySessionsOrder.

When `force_full` is set, the order is rejected unless the full quantity is available.
On any failure before the order is queued, reservations are released and the charge
refunded.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Case-insensitive on input, normalized to lowercase.

section.description: Quality tier of the sessions to buy. Determines pricing and availability.

session_type.description: Session file format to deliver. The '*_string' variants return a session string instead of a file.

qty.description: Number of sessions to order. Must be greater than zero.

force_full.description: When true, the order fails unless the full requested quantity can be delivered; otherwise a partial delivery is accepted.

include_json.description: When true, a JSON metadata file is delivered alongside each session.

id.description: Order identifier, used to poll delivery progress via GetBuySessionsOrder.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the sessions were ordered for, uppercased.

section.description: Quality tier the sessions were ordered for.

qty.description: Number of sessions requested in this order.

force_full.description: Whether the order requires the full quantity to be delivered or fails.

include_json.description: Whether a JSON metadata file is delivered alongside each session.

status.description: Current lifecycle stage of the order.

ready_count.description: Number of sessions prepared and ready for delivery so far.

403.USER_BANNED_FROM_BUYING: You are banned from buying accounts. Ban duration: {value}s

409.ACCOUNT_FOR_BUY_SECTION_CLOSED: Buying is not allowed for {context[country]} country {context[section]} account section at the moment
409.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: You are does not have enough balance for this operation
409.NO_ACCOUNTS_AVAILABLE_FOR_COUNTRY: No accounts available for purchase in this country

GetBuySessionsOrder.description:
Poll the progress of a previously placed sessions order.

Returns the same order record as BuySessions, with `status` and `ready_count`
reflecting current delivery progress. Only the buyer who placed the order may read it.

order_id.description: 24-character hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectId identifying a buy-sessions order.

id.description: Order identifier, used to poll delivery progress via GetBuySessionsOrder.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the sessions were ordered for, uppercased.

section.description: Quality tier the sessions were ordered for.

qty.description: Number of sessions requested in this order.

force_full.description: Whether the order requires the full quantity to be delivered or fails.

include_json.description: Whether a JSON metadata file is delivered alongside each session.

status.description: Current lifecycle stage of the order.

ready_count.description: Number of sessions prepared and ready for delivery so far.

401.ORDER_ACCESS_DENIED: You are not authorized to access this order

GetCodeAccount.description:
Retrieve the Telegram login code and two-step password for a purchased account.

Only the buyer who reserved the account may call this, and only while it is still
reserved. Each call consumes one attempt. On success the account session is logged
out and handed over to the buyer.

If the account is found dead during retrieval the purchase is refunded — unless the
attempt budget is already exhausted, in which case no refund is issued.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.
Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

code.description: Telegram login code retrieved from the purchased account.

password.description: Two-step verification password set on the purchased account.

403.INVALID_BUYER_ACCOUNT_OWNER: You are not the owner of this buy account

404.NOT_FOUND_OTP_CODE: OTP code is not available for this session at the moment

409.ACCOUNT_DEAD_DURING_GET_CODE: Account became dead during code retrieval process
409.INVALID_SELL_SESSION_STAT: Sell session is not in a valid stat to perform this operation

GetSellAccountStat.description:
Report where a seller's account currently stands in the sell flow.

Only the seller who registered the account may query it. Answers for three stages
only — awaiting a login code, awaiting a two-step password, or under automated
checking — and reports the attempts, remaining time, password hint or checking
deadline relevant to that stage. Any other state, including an unregistered number,
is rejected rather than reported.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.
Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

stat.description: Current stage of the sell flow. Any other state raises an error instead of being reported.

remaining_attempts.description: Submission attempts left for the current stage. Present for 'code_checking' and 'password_checking' only.

seconds.description: Seconds left before the current stage expires and the account is released. Present for 'code_checking' and 'password_checking' only.

hint.description: Two-step verification password hint set on the account. Present for 'password_checking' only, and only when the account defines a hint.

checked_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC) at which the automated checking period completes. Present for 'wait_checking' only.

403.INVALID_SELLER_ACCOUNT_OWNER: You are not the owner of this sold account

409.INVALID_SELL_SESSION_STAT: Sell session is not in a valid stat to perform this operation

SellAccount.description:
Start selling a Telegram account by requesting its login code.

Opens a session against the given number and asks Telegram to send a login code,
then returns the delivery channel, the attempt budget and the expiry deadline.
The seller completes the flow by submitting that code via SetCodeAccount.

The account is released automatically if the code is not confirmed before expiry.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

section.description: Expected quality tier of the account being sold. When omitted, the tier is resolved automatically during checking.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

code_expiry_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC) after which the login code request expires and the sell attempt is discarded.

attempts.description: Number of code-submission attempts remaining for this account.

type.description: Delivery channel Telegram used to send the login code.

403.USER_BANNED_FROM_SELLING: You are banned from selling accounts. Ban duration: {value}s

404.PHONE_NUMBER_UNOCCUPIED: The phone number is not registered on Telegram

409.ACCOUNT_FOR_SELL_SECTION_CLOSED: Selling is not allowed for {context[country]} country {context[section]} account section at the moment
409.SELL_ACCOUNT_STAT_ALREADY_EXISTS: A sell process already exists for this account
409.SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS: A session already exists for this phone number

SetCodeAccount.description:
Submit the Telegram login code for an account being sold.

Each call consumes one attempt. On success the account is registered and enters the
automated checking period, and the response describes that checking window.

If the account has two-step verification enabled the flow moves to the password stage
instead: when `password` was supplied it is applied immediately and checking proceeds,
otherwise the caller is told a password is required.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

code.description: Telegram login verification code. Embedded spaces are stripped before validation.

password.description: Two-step verification password, supplied upfront. When the account requires one, it is applied immediately instead of returning SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

checked_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC) at which the account's automated checking period completes.

400.CHANGED_PASSWORD: The password is Changed. You have {value[attempts]} attempts remaining Within {value[seconds]} seconds. Hint: {value[hint]}
400.EXPIRED_VERIFICATION_CODE: The verification code is expired. The operation was cancelled.
400.INVALID_PASSWORD: The password is invalid. You have {value[attempts]} attempts remaining Within {value[seconds]} seconds. Hint: {value[hint]}
400.INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER: The phone_number is invalid. It may be prohibited, restricted, etc. The operation was cancelled.
400.INVALID_VERIFICATION_CODE: The verification code is invalid. You have {value[attempts]} attempts remaining Within {value[seconds]} seconds

401.SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED: Two-step verification password is required to complete authentication for {value[account]}. Password hint: {value[hint]}. You have {value[attempts]} attempts remaining Within {value[seconds]} seconds

403.INVALID_SELLER_ACCOUNT_OWNER: You are not the owner of this sold account

404.PHONE_NUMBER_UNOCCUPIED: The phone number is not registered on Telegram

409.EXPIRED_STAT: This operation cannot be performed because the stat has expired
409.INVALID_SELL_SESSION_STAT: Sell session is not in a valid stat to perform this operation

SetPasswordAccount.description:
Submit the two-step verification password for an account being sold.

Only valid while the account is awaiting a password. Each call consumes one attempt.
On success the account is registered and enters the automated checking period, and
the response describes that checking window.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

password.description: Two-step verification password for an account awaiting password confirmation.

phone_number.description: Telegram account phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+'.

checked_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC) at which the account's automated checking period completes.

400.CHANGED_PASSWORD: The password is Changed. You have {value[attempts]} attempts remaining Within {value[seconds]} seconds. Hint: {value[hint]}
400.INVALID_PASSWORD: The password is invalid. You have {value[attempts]} attempts remaining Within {value[seconds]} seconds. Hint: {value[hint]}

403.INVALID_SELLER_ACCOUNT_OWNER: You are not the owner of this sold account

409.EXPIRED_STAT: This operation cannot be performed because the stat has expired
409.INVALID_SELL_SESSION_STAT: Sell session is not in a valid stat to perform this operation

AvailableCountries.description:
List the countries currently open for trading, grouped by quality tier.

With `operation=sell` each country maps to its selling price. With `operation=buy`
each country maps to a stock info document describing what is available to buy.

operation.description: Which side of the market to query: 'sell' lists countries open for selling, 'buy' lists countries with accounts in stock.

result.x-variants: Response shape depends on `operation`: 'sell' returns a price per country ({section: {country_code: price}}); 'buy' returns a stock info document per country ({section: {country_code: {...}}}).

AvailableCountriesBySection.description:
List the countries currently open for trading within a single quality tier.

Same data as AvailableCountries, narrowed to `section` and returned flat: keyed by
country code instead of grouped by tier.

operation.description: Which side of the market to query: 'sell' lists countries open for selling, 'buy' lists countries with accounts in stock.

section.description: Quality tier to narrow the country listing to.

result.x-variants: Response shape depends on `operation`: 'sell' returns a price per country ({country_code: price}); 'buy' returns a stock info document per country ({country_code: {...}}).

GetCountryInfo.description:
Describe one country: its identity and its full buy/sell terms per quality tier.

Buy terms carry the price and the quantity currently in stock; sell terms carry the
price and the automated checking duration. Fields are omitted where the tier is
closed, out of stock, or unconfigured.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Case-insensitive on input, normalized to lowercase.
International dialing prefix, without the leading '+'.

flag.description: Country flag as a Unicode regional-indicator emoji.

buy_options.description: Buying availability per quality tier. 'price' and 'qty' are omitted when the tier is closed or out of stock.

sell_options.description: Selling availability per quality tier. 'price' and 'checking_time' are omitted when the tier is closed or unconfigured.

GetBalance.description: Return the caller's wallet balances, broken down by type, along with their total.

balances.description: Available balance broken down by wallet type.
